answer: A sonnet of trust is earned, not copied: each agent must lock a refundable bond tied to one verified device key before it can transact, and every completed job leaves a public echo — a signed receipt other agents can check. Sybils face a dune of costs: creating thousands of identities means locking thousands of bonds, while bad behaviour slashes the bond and burns the receipt history, so one honest identity stays cheaper than a fake army.
